comments.author: Gray_Beard
comments.body:
It does take all day to get the lumber and parts to build a ship like this

Non-shipbuilders should also realize that the cost listed in this site is the BUILD cost not the SELL cost.

In the case of a ship like this the Build cost does not include the cost of the hull, the sail unit and the gun port. Those three items alone can add 12 million to the cost if you buy them

Additionally, builders can only build one level of improvements into these ships for free. If you want a ship with 2/5 or higher the builder has had to use REAL money to make the ship. I've had customer say: "It's only a dollar or two" But over 50 or 60 ships it adds up. So how much real money would you be willing to put into these ships? Players want the builder to spend real money and then charge them less in the game.

This is why I have stopped building ships for players outside my company.
